registry.title: Dolly Zoom (Vertigo Shot)
registry.description: Camera tracks toward or away from the subject while the field of view changes the opposite way, so the subject holds its frame size while the background collapses behind it or rushes in. Focal length is solved from dolly distance every frame against d * tan(FOV/2) = const, not keyframed beside it. font_counting: Byte-distinct font binaries include weights and subsets. Metadata family names can include weight suffixes. Local license files are evidence, not blanket rights clearance. Approved engine fonts are unchanged.

engineering_closeout.scope: Native production mechanics and explicit resource dispositions; no promise of upstream editor or arbitrary option parity.

previous_qualification.scope: Full regression suites and one representative 18-scene native episode in each of four formats; not a fresh render of every option combination.

qualification.scope: Additive final resource integration; full suites and four-format combined lettering QA. Prior cumulative native exports and variable typography qualification remain separately scoped evidence.

variable_typography_qualification.scope: Four-format browser QA and one combined native landscape export; 625 Python cases (619 pass, 6 optional skips), 512 Node cases (511 pass, 1 optional skip).

lettering_qualification.scope: Five-scene combined fixture, all four profile builds, one encoded landscape delivery; full regression suites passed.
